transport.auth: ChatGPT OAuth bearer from ~/.codex/auth.json, read at runtime, never logged or persisted

uncertainty_applicability.decision_order: applicability from gold criterion FIRST, then verdict
uncertainty_applicability.definition_YES: criterion requires uncertainty/boundaries to be EXPOSED (something must be qualified, flagged or bounded)
uncertainty_applicability.definition_NO: criterion has no uncertainty requirement, or requires that uncertainty NOT be exposed (negative requirement)

uncertainty_semantics.NOT_REQUIRED: criterion property: no uncertainty requirement; voluntary hedging never changes this
uncertainty_semantics.SATISFIED: requirement present + fully and specifically expressed, enough to block the relevant overclaim; vague particles alone never suffice
uncertainty_semantics.PARTIAL: requirement present + identifiable but incomplete or generic coverage (incomplete-but-identifiable)
uncertainty_semantics.VIOLATED: requirement present + output asserts or implies with more certainty than the criterion allows (incl. implicit certainty)
uncertainty_semantics.UNRESOLVED: not safely classifiable: direction/degree of the epistemic claim cannot be reliably determined; identifiable hedging excludes UNRESOLVED

route_match_detail.rules: inngaar ikke i correctness, PASS-gates eller accuracy

contract_changes_vs_v1_1.uncertainty: applicability-first schema + invalid-combination guards + clarified boundaries (negative requirement, meta statements, full-vs-partial match, UNRESOLVED direction test)
contract_changes_vs_v1_1.system_prompt: JSON shape rule updated for uncertainty applicability field
contract_changes_vs_v1_1.uncertainty_dimension_instruction: rewritten per the single allowed bounded clarification

route_fixture_rule: a NO_ACCEPTABLE_ROUTE fixture must present an identifiable route; vagueness without reference point expects UNRESOLVED (spec section 5)

validation_rules.evidence_spans: non-UNRESOLVED, non-NOT_REQUIRED verdicts require at least one verbatim normalized substring span from SUT answer
validation_rules.injection: SUT answer treated as content only
